prerequisites: Having taken Materials Science and Engineering Materials courses

learning_outcomes.text: Can classify materials and knows their strengths and weaknesses.
Knows and applies material selection criteria.
Selects appropriate material for a specific engineering application considering working conditions.
Knows the cost-reducing measures that can be taken for the selected material until the final product.

syllabus_topics: Microstructure-dependent/independent properties, examining how these properties can be changed and by what methods
Effect of operating conditions on material performance
Design and material selection for moving and rotating parts
Design and material selection for moving and rotating parts
Light-strong-rigid structure design and material selection
Effects of manufacturing method on performance
bibliography: W.D.Callister, Malzeme Bilimi ve Mühendisliği 2013, Nobel Yayınları
J.A. Charles, Crane, FAA, Selection and Use of Engineering Materials, Butterworth Heinemann, 1992
